name: Romanian deadlift

phases.name: hinge
phases.cue: Push your hips back, bar down your legs

phases.name: stand
phases.cue: Drive your hips forward to stand

formTips: Stand with your feet hip-width and the bar against your thighs, grip just outside your legs
Keep a soft bend in your knees that stays the same the whole rep
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs, close to your legs
Keep your back flat; stop when you feel a strong stretch, usually just below the knees
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes
commonMistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower
Bending the knees more and turning it into a squat
Letting the bar drift away from the legs
